heading: INT. DEEP SPACE RELAY STATION - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. DEEP SPACE RELAY STATION - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT CYCLE
Brass-toned consoles, curved glass, a chart table out of some earlier century's idea of the future.
Soft music plays from a hidden speaker.
A blue star turns slowly beyond the viewport.
COMMANDER EVELYN ADEYEMI, 50s, in a crisp gray uniform, stands at a console with a cup of tea.
Beside her, the station's navigator LIEUTENANT PIERRE DUMONT, 30s, leans on the chart table over a spread of star maps.
At the communications desk, the young radio operator ENSIGN TAMSIN BELL, 20s, wears a headset and absentmindedly twirls a pencil.
A soft chime.
Tamsin sits up.
Commander. Incoming signal on the long channel.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Source?
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: Unknown. Wide beam, no authentication.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Probably a drifter.
units.name: PIERRE

units.text: Probably.
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: Tamsin flips a switch.
A hush of static fills the room, and out of it a voice, warm, old, faintly amused, as if from the bottom of a well.
Relay Station Nine, this is a friend. Please do not be alarmed.
units.name: VOICE

units.text: Pierre and Tamsin exchange a look.
Evelyn sets her tea down.
Identify yourself.
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: Names are a luxury. Call me the Traveler.
units.name: VOICE

units.text: That's not a ship's name.
units.name: PIERRE

units.text: I am not a ship.
units.name: TRAVELER

units.text: The lights dim.
A shape begins to resolve in the viewport, a tall, indistinct column of pale light rising out of the star's glare.
Tamsin takes off her headset.
Ensign. Raise the shields.
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: They're up, Commander. They've been up.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: There is no need. I am here only to deliver a warning.
units.name: TRAVELER

units.text: The pale shape leans closer to the glass.
Pierre steps back and knocks a star map to the floor.
Evelyn does not blink.
What warning?
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: The shape raises what might be a hand.
In the viewport, the blue star flickers once, twice.
Your sun is not what you think.
units.name: TRAVELER

units.text: Silence.
The music, absurdly, continues.
Evelyn crosses to the speaker, finds the knob, and turns it off.
Go on.
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: The Traveler's voice, when it comes, is very gentle.
It is a door. And somebody is knocking.
units.name: TRAVELER

units.text: Evelyn looks at Pierre and Tamsin.
Neither speaks.
Beyond the glass, the blue star flickers a third time, and the whole station groans like a ship in a swell.
Commander, I think we should go home.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: We are home.
units.name: EVELYN

units.text: The shape in the window lowers its hand, and the star goes dark.
